aboutHeading: Angeli Horticulture: Brunswick East's Trusted Gardener
aboutText: With nearly 20 years of experience, Angeli Horticulture has been transforming gardens across Brunswick East. Our team of skilled horticulturists provides comprehensive services from design to regular maintenance, ensuring your outdoor space thrives. We pride ourselves on personalised service and attention to detail, tailored to the unique needs of Brunswick East properties.
servicesText: At Angeli Horticulture, we offer a wide range of gardening services designed to keep your property in top condition. Whether you need a complete garden overhaul or regular upkeep, our professional team delivers exceptional results with a focus on sustainability.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: We create custom garden designs that enhance your property's appeal and suit Brunswick East's environment.

services.title: Lawn Care & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular mowing, fertilising, and weed control to keep your lawn healthy and lush throughout the year.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of trees, shrubs, and flowers to add colour and life to your garden.

services.title: Hard Landscaping & Paving
services.desc: Installation of paths, patios, and retaining walls using quality materials for durable outdoor features.

services.title: Irrigation Systems
services.desc: Efficient watering solutions to conserve water and ensure your garden receives the right amount of moisture.

services.title: Seasonal Clean-ups
services.desc: Thorough garden clean-ups in spring and autumn to remove debris and prepare your garden for the next season.
